title: Just Weather Scoring: Efficient End-to-end Nowcasting with Distributional Diffusion
title_zh: Just Weather Scoring: 效率极高的端到端 Nowcasting 与分布扩散生成

paragraphs.en: Just Weather Scoring (JWS) 是一种单阶段扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行天气预测，简化了训练和推理过程，提高了效率。 Generative diffusion models are well-suited for probabilistic precipitation nowcasting, but existing approaches often rely on separately trained compression or deterministic forecasting components and remain costly at inference due to iterative denoising. We introduce Just Weather Scoring (JWS), a single-stage, end-to-end diffusion model which addresses both issues by forecasting directly in radar space and enabling few-step generation. Radar-space modeling greatly simplifies training and inference and eliminates uncertainty arising from lossy compression. JWS combines Masked Asynchronous Diffusion, a timestep-sampling scheme that preserves clean context while adapting diffusion training to high-dimensional spatio-temporal data, with a simple scoring-rule objective that aligns training with probabilistic forecasting and unlocks few-step generation. On the SEVIR and MeteoNet benchmarks, JWS achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at reduced training and inference cost. Even our smallest model remains competitive using substantially fewer parameters and more than 17x faster inference.
paragraphs.zh: Just Weather Scoring (JWS) 是一种单阶段扩散模型，直接在雷达空间进行天气预测，简化了训练和推理过程，提高了效率。生成式扩散模型非常适合概率性降水短时预报，但现有方法通常依赖单独训练的压缩或确定性预报组件，并且由于迭代去噪，在推理阶段成本仍然很高。 我们提出了 Just Weather Scoring (JWS)，这是一种单阶段、端到端的扩散模型，通过直接在雷达空间进行预测并支持少步生成，解决了上述两个问题。 在雷达空间中进行建模极大地简化了训练和推理过程，并消除了无损压缩带来的不确定性。 JWS 结合了掩码异步扩散（Masked Asynchronous Diffusion）——一种能够保留纯净上下文同时将扩散训练适配于高维时空数据的时步采样方案——以及一个简单的评分规则目标函数，该目标函数使训练与概率性预报保持一致，并实现了少步生成。 在 SEVIR 和 MeteoNet 基准测试中，JWS 以较低的训练和推理成本实现了当前最先进的概率性预报性能。 即使是我们最小的模型，在参数数量大幅减少且推理速度提升超过 17 倍的情况下，仍然具有竞争力。
